lines.text: This tiny peacock mantis shrimp delivers the fastest punch in the animal kingdom.
Accelerating faster than a bullet fired from a handgun.
Its dactyl clubs strike with over ten thousand Gs of acceleration.
Reaching fifty miles per hour in less than three milliseconds.
The club moves so fast underwater that it rips water molecules apart.
When these vacuum bubbles instantly collapse under ocean pressure,
they generate temperatures exceeding eight thousand degrees Fahrenheit.
Nearly as hot as the surface of the sun.
Releasing a shockwave and an invisible micro-flash of light.
Even if the shrimp misses the target completely,
the collapsing shockwave alone shatters heavy crab armor.
Delivering two devastating impacts in a single strike.
Meet nature's deadliest underwater heavyweight boxer.
